goal: Defeat Erika for the Rainbow Badge

subgoals.goal_text: Travel from Cerulean City to Celadon City. Note that the direct route south from Cerulean is blocked; use the route via Route 9, Route 10, and the Underground Path or other known paths to reach Celadon.
Visit the Pokemon Center in Celadon City to heal the party.
Battle and defeat Gym Leader Erika.
